body.purpose: Navigation, body copy, labels, metadata, and controls.

shadows.name: folio-lift
shadows.purpose: Lift the full folio from its surrounding green ground.

motion.name: folio-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal an expanded sample document from the top down.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The main route into the public document collection.
components.html: Browse public documents
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;min-height:52px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:22px;padding:0 20px;background:var(--accent,#d9ef63);color:var(--ink,#183c34);font:700 14px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease}.ds-primary svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:0 0 auto;transition:transform 180ms ease}.ds-primary:hover{background:var(--ink,#183c34);color:var(--paper,#f8f8f0)}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#d9ef63);outline-offset:4px}.ds-primary:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}

components.name: Spine navigation
components.description: Two in-page destinations held in the dark folio spine.
components.css: .ds-spine-nav{display:grid;gap:8px;background:var(--ink,#183c34);padding:12px}.ds-spine-nav a{display:flex;min-height:46px;align-items:center;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid transparent;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper,#f8f8f0) 76%,var(--ink,#183c34));font:14px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;transition:border-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,background-color 180ms ease}.ds-spine-nav a:hover,.ds-spine-nav .ds-active{border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper,#f8f8f0) 22%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper,#f8f8f0) 8%,var(--ink,#183c34));color:var(--paper,#f8f8f0)}.ds-active::before{width:7px;height:7px;margin-right:12px;background:var(--accent,#d9ef63);content:""}.ds-spine-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#d9ef63);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Organizer preview
components.description: A concise configurable profile preview with a route to public files.
components.css: .ds-organizer{padding:21px 22px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line,#c6d0c3);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--brand-paper,#e9eee2) 54%,var(--paper,#f8f8f0));color:var(--ink,#183c34)}.ds-avatar{display:grid;width:72px;height:72px;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink,#183c34);color:var(--accent,#d9ef63);font:28px 'Young Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-organizer h2{margin:12px 0 0;font:25px 'Young Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-organizer p{color:var(--quiet,#50675d);font:13px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.ds-organizer a{color:var(--ink,#183c34);font:12px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;text-underline-offset:4px}.ds-organizer a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-organizer a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#d9ef63);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Document disclosure
components.description: A ruled public-file row that expands into an explicitly labeled sample preview.
components.css: .ds-document{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#c6d0c3);color:var(--ink,#183c34)}.ds-document summary{display:flex;min-height:78px;align-items:center;gap:16px;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-document summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-tab{display:grid;width:38px;height:44px;place-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line,#c6d0c3);background:var(--brand-paper,#e9eee2);font:19px 'Young Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-document small,.ds-document strong{display:block}.ds-document small{color:var(--quiet,#50675d);font:11px Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.ds-document strong{margin-top:4px;font:20px 'Young Serif',Georgia,serif}.ds-toggle{position:relative;width:24px;height:24px;margin-left:auto;border:1px solid var(--line,#c6d0c3);border-radius:50%}.ds-document p{padding:0 0 18px 54px;font:14px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}.ds-document summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#d9ef63);outline-offset:3px}.ds-toggle::before,.ds-toggle::after{position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;width:8px;height:1px;background:var(--ink,#183c34);content:"";transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.ds-toggle::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg);transition:transform 180ms ease}.ds-document[open] .ds-toggle::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}

components.name: Sample label
components.description: A restrained label that distinguishes illustrative files from real event documents.

narrative.overview: Potokuadrat is a guest folio made for the web. Its pages introduce the organizer and open directly into a useful public document index. The printed welcome packet informs the dark spine, open pale spread, ruled entries, and bright leaf tab.
keyCharacteristics: The dark folio spine makes the event name and page destinations easy to find.
A configurable lime accent marks the primary action and current section.
Young Serif gives headings a printed character; Arial keeps navigation and metadata practical.
Ruled document rows keep the public collection direct and scannable.

rules.name: One Welcome Rule
rules.body: Introduce the organizer before asking visitors to browse the collection.

rules.name: Honest Sample Rule
rules.body: Mark illustrative documents as sample material until the organizer replaces them.

rules.name: One Accent Rule
rules.body: Reserve the leaf accent for the primary action and active section.

dos: Do keep the event name, organizer details, page description, and palette configurable in config.json.
Do label all fabricated document content as sample material until an organizer replaces it.
Do keep the first viewport focused on the organizer and public-document action.
donts: Don't imply that example files, biographies, event dates, or client references are real.
Don't turn the document index into a uniform social-media card grid.
Don't add decorative gradients, glass effects, or icon glyphs that compete with the folio's printed structure.
